formCommon.intro: We have just sent you to your inbox the following documents. Please read these carefully. By clicking on "Continue", you confirm that your personal data is correct, you have received and read all documents and you agree to the terms of the contract.
formCommon.confirmMonthlyIncome: I confirm that the amount of my investment does not exceed the amount equivalent to twice my average monthly net income.

form1000.p1: According to the results of our audit, your knowledge or experience is not sufficient to allow you to assess the risks associated with an investment in this financial instrument. Therefore, it does not seem appropriate to invest in it. After acknowledging and confirming this warning, however, you can continue with the subscription and make an investment in the financial instrument. By clicking "Continue", you confirm that you have taken note of this warning.
form1000.p2: To continue with your investment, you must confirm at least one of the following two statements. Please answer truthfully.
form1000.confirmAsset: I confirm that I have freely available assets in the form of bank deposits and financial instruments for a minimum amount of {amount}.
form1000.error: You must select at least one of the options.

form10000.p1: We do not have all the requested information in order to assess whether you can evaluate the risks associated with an investment in this financial instrument. In this regard, we cannot perform a suitability test, i.e. whether an investment may be unsuitable. After acknowledging and confirming this warning, you can continue with the subscription and make an investment in the financial instrument. By clicking "Continue", you confirm that you have taken note of this warning.

step3.title: Authorize Payment
step3.directDebitInfo: By clicking "Authorize & Invest", you authorize a SEPA direct debit from your bank account. The payment will be captured automatically once your investment passes compliance review.
step3.success: Investment created successfully! Your payment is authorized and will be captured after compliance approval.
